sentences.zh: 因为我记得，比如我爸爸有一瓶新奇的利口酒，我想，它装在一个驿马车造型的瓶子里。

sentences.en: I don't know.

sentences.zh: 但我要说的是，有趣的是，那些额外的笑话——也就是没有放进围读初稿里的那些——会被保存在那个“糖果袋”文档里。

sentences.en: And then if a joke didn't land at the table read, they might go over there and replace it when it came time for the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果某个笑话在围读时没能达到预期效果，当要敲定拍摄版剧本时，他们可能会去那里找个替换掉它。

sentences.zh: 或者他们会让我们在片场直接演出来。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 所有不同的备选台词。

sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: Sometimes I think the writers just wanted to hear them just for fun.
sentences.zh: 有时我觉得编剧写这些台词纯粹是为了好玩。

sentences.en: Even though they knew we weren't going to, like, use any of them, they would hand you a page.
sentences.zh: 哪怕他们知道我们可能根本不会采用其中的任何一句，他们还是会递给你一张纸页。

sentences.en: And if we had time that day in our shooting schedule, we would just do a whole bunch of alts.
sentences.zh: 如果那天拍摄日程有空余，我们就会把所有的备用台词全演一遍。

sentences.en: And it was always so fun.
sentences.zh: 而且总是那么有趣。

sentences.en: Stanley thinks Michael should start looking for another job.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利觉得迈克尔应该开始找另一份工作了。

sentences.en: Michael says he has a job, to which Andy points out for four more days.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说他有工作，安迪则指出这份工作只剩四天了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Andy's like, you kind of got to get your act together here.
sentences.zh: 安迪的意思是，你在这里得有点紧迫感才行。

sentences.en: Well, Michael has a talking head where he is not worried.
sentences.zh: 好吧，迈克尔有一段对着镜头说话的独白，他在里面一点也不担心。

sentences.en: I mean, what's he going to do?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他打算怎么做？

sentences.en: He's going to do a little bit of this, a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 他打算这样弄一点，那样弄一点。

sentences.en: And he's going to stop worrying about calories.
sentences.zh: 然后他就不打算再为卡路里操心了。

sentences.en: So during this whole montage of, like, people giving Michael advice, there was a scene in the shooting draft that didn't make it.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一整段大家给迈克尔提建议的剪辑中，拍摄剧本里其实有一个场景没能播出来。

sentences.en: And Kelly walks into his office and she's like, Michael, what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 凯莉走进他的办公室说，迈克尔，你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: You know what I would do?
sentences.zh: 你知道我会怎么做吗？

sentences.en: I'd move to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 我会搬到墨西哥去。

sentences.en: I'd live on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我会住在海滩上。

sentences.en: I'd be naked.
sentences.zh: 我会光着身子。

sentences.en: I'd make jewelry, have amazing sex, drink lots of margaritas.
sentences.zh: 我会做首饰，享受极棒的性爱，喝大量的玛格丽特酒。

sentences.en: She just kind of goes off on this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 她就这样滔滔不绝地说了一大堆。

sentences.en: And while Kelly is rambling on and on about what she would do, he is carving into his desk.
sentences.zh: 就在凯莉喋喋不休地讲她会怎么做的时候，他在办公桌上刻起字来。

sentences.en: Michael was here.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔到此一游。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And he really carved into the top of the desk.
sentences.zh: 而且他是真的在桌子表面上刻了字。

sentences.en: I was like, did we trash a desk for this, like, scene that never even made it in?
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我们为了这么一个甚至都没被剪进去的场景，竟然毁了一张桌子吗？

sentences.en: And I wasn't the only one that noticed.
sentences.zh: 而且不只是我一个人注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: Olivia C.
sentences.zh: 奥利维亚·C。

sentences.en: wrote in and said, in the deleted scenes, they're on the DVD box set, guys.
sentences.zh: 写信来说，在 DVD 套装的删减片段里，伙计们。

sentences.en: We see that Michael has carved.
sentences.zh: 我们看到迈克尔刻下了字。

sentences.en: Michael was here on the desk.
sentences.zh: 桌上刻着“迈克尔到此一游”。

sentences.en: Did Steve really carve that into the desk?
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫真的是在桌子上刻的吗？

sentences.en: Olivia, I had the same question.
sentences.zh: 奥利维亚，我也有同样的疑问。

sentences.en: But guess what?
sentences.zh: 但你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: Randy Cordray had the answer.
sentences.zh: 兰迪·科德雷给出了答案。

sentences.en: He said our production designer, Michael Gallenberg, created a matching desktop out of the exact same similar wood.
sentences.zh: 他说我们的布景设计师迈克尔·盖伦伯格用完全相同相似的木头制作了一个配套的桌面。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: That was laminated over the actual desktop because we were shooting scenes out of order,
sentences.zh: 那是贴在真实桌面上的压层板，因为我们是跨场次拍摄的，

sentences.en: and they couldn't have different stages of Michael carving into his desk in the episode because then it wouldn't match.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不能让剧集中迈克尔刻桌子的进度前后不一致，否则就对不上了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So they just had this laminate top they would put on top, and then they would take it away.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只是准备了这么一块压层板盖在上面，用完再拿掉。

sentences.en: Now, let me ask you this question.
sentences.zh: 现在，我问你这个问题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That means that Veda, our script supervisor, would have had a chart, and on that chart, for each scene, it would say, carve desk, no carve desk.
sentences.zh: 那就意味着我们的场记维达会有一张表，表上会针对每个场景标明：要刻桌子，还是不要刻桌子。

sentences.en: She would have tracked when we should see the carving.
sentences.zh: 她会追踪我们什么时候该看到桌上的刻字。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But they didn't know they were going to cut this scene until later.
sentences.zh: 但他们直到后来才知道要剪掉这个场景。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: So is it possible that we can see this carving on his desk throughout the episode?
sentences.zh: 那么我们有没有可能在这集的任何地方看到他桌上的这个雕刻呢？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: You'd have to be close, right?
sentences.zh: 你得凑得很近才行，对吧？

sentences.en: Like over his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 就像在他肩膀后面那种。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But, I mean, probably what a headache for Veda, like keeping track of all that, and then it didn't even make it in.
sentences.zh: 不过，我是说，这对薇达来说得多头疼啊，还得留意所有这些，结果最后还没用上。

sentences.en: I'll have you know, Angela, at 2 minutes 48 seconds, we had a fan catch from Flora K.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我得告诉你，在2分48秒的时候，我们收到了一位名叫芙萝拉·K的粉丝的发现。

sentences.en: There is a blooming plant at reception.
sentences.zh: 前台有一盆开花的植物。

sentences.en: Flora!
sentences.zh: 芙萝拉！

sentences.en: Good catch!
sentences.zh: 好眼力！

sentences.en: I knew it would make your heart happy, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我知道这会让你很高兴，安吉拉。

sentences.en: I saw it too, Flora.
sentences.zh: 我也看到了，芙萝拉。

sentences.en: You know, the last time we had a blooming plant at reception was Beach Games.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们上次在前台看到开花的植物还是在《海滩运动会》那集。

sentences.en: So you think this is connected to Pam?
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得这跟帕姆有关？

sentences.en: Pam is going to have her moment here.
sentences.zh: 帕姆在这里要高光时刻了。

sentences.en: She's going to have another moment.
sentences.zh: 她还会有另一个高光时刻。

sentences.en: She's going to bloom again today, like in Beach Games.
sentences.zh: 她今天会再次绽放，就像在《海滩运动会》里那样。

sentences.en: Now, I know we talked to Steve Ducharer, who told us that it was a coincidence that it was a blooming plant for Beach Games.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道我们跟史蒂夫·迪沙雷聊过，他告诉我们《海滩运动会》里出现开花的植物纯属巧合。

sentences.en: But Steve Ducharer, again, with the blooming plant, Pam is blooming.
sentences.zh: 但史蒂夫·迪沙雷，又是开花的植物，帕姆正在绽放。

sentences.en: I think it was subconscious.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是潜意识的。

sentences.en: This is that group mind thing.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种群体思维的事。

sentences.en: That's what I was going to say.
sentences.zh: 这也是我正要说的。

sentences.en: This is creative group mind.
sentences.zh: 这是创造性的群体思维。

sentences.en: Well, Michael is now going to move into the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 好了，迈克尔现在要走进厨房了。

sentences.en: I guess he's hungry.
sentences.zh: 我猜他饿了。

sentences.en: So he's looking for some food.
sentences.zh: 所以他在找吃的。

sentences.en: He's a little tipsy, and he's going to go, like, raid the refrigerator.
sentences.zh: 他有点喝醉了，打算去洗劫冰箱。

sentences.en: Who hasn't been there?
sentences.zh: 谁没经历过这事呢？

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 得了吧。

sentences.zh: 剧本里只写着迈克尔拿出一个明显贴有菲莉丝标签的容器。

sentences.en: But you know how he's eating it, and then he's like, ugh, Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 但你知道他是怎么吃的，然后他就一副“呃，菲莉丝”的表情。

sentences.en: None of that was in the script.
sentences.zh: 这些在剧本里全都没有。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 哦，真的吗？

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Steve just improvised that.
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: Oh, that's so good.
sentences.zh: 哦，那太棒了。

sentences.en: Andy comes in, and he wants to give Michael some wine as a farewell gift.
sentences.zh: 安迪进来了，他想送迈克尔一些酒作为告别礼物。

sentences.en: It's actually a really nice gesture.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一个非常暖心的举动。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And Michael just doesn't give a crap.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔根本不在乎。

sentences.en: Michael would love it if Jim came in and gave him a bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 要是吉姆进来送他一瓶酒，迈克尔可会喜欢死了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's Andy, so he's like, ugh, I already have wine.
sentences.zh: 但你知道的，那是安迪，所以他就觉得，呃，我已经有酒了。

sentences.en: This next scene I loved because Michael's sitting on the couch by front reception, and a man walks in.
sentences.zh: 我超喜欢接下来这场戏，因为迈克尔坐在前台旁边的沙发上，然后有个男人走了进来。

sentences.en: He's interviewing for Michael's job.
sentences.zh: 他在面试迈克尔的工作。

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael is kind of on the couch reading a novel.
sentences.zh: 对，迈克尔有点像在沙发上看小说。

sentences.en: I zoomed in on it.
sentences.zh: 我把镜头拉近了。

sentences.en: I tried to see what it was.
sentences.zh: 我试图看清那是什么书。

sentences.en: It's like a woman in a martini glass.
sentences.zh: 封面好像是一个坐在马提尼酒杯里的女人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's clearly like a sort of—
sentences.zh: 这显然有点像一种——

sentences.en: A romance novel?
sentences.zh: 言情小说？

sentences.en: No, it seems like one of those, like, books for women about, you know, claim your space sort of book.
sentences.zh: 不，感觉像是那种，你知道的，写给女性的关于“活出自我”之类的书。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, like a motivational—
sentences.zh: 对，对，就像一本励志——

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's what it looked like to me.
sentences.zh: 我看起来也是这样。

sentences.en: I want you to know a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 我想让你知道几件事。

sentences.zh: 在4分16秒时，那盆开花的植物动了。

sentences.en: It's been moved to the other side of the reception desk.
sentences.zh: 它被移到了接待台的另一边。

sentences.en: So you can see the couch better.
sentences.zh: 这样你们能看得更清楚沙发。

sentences.en: The man who's interviewing for the job is named Mr. Isaac Sylvie, and Aaron Schur told us that he was named after Aaron's kids, Isaac and Sylvie.
sentences.zh: 那个来面试的人叫艾萨克·西尔维先生（Mr. Isaac Sylvie），亚伦·舒尔（Aaron Schur）告诉我们，这个名字是用亚伦的孩子艾萨克和西尔维的名字命名的。

sentences.en: Isn't that so cute?
sentences.zh: 这不是很可爱吗？

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 对啊！

sentences.en: He had originally named the character Mr. Engbritsen, but Paul Lieberstein told him, no, name him after your kids.
sentences.zh: 他原本给这个角色取名叫恩格布里森先生（Mr. Engbritsen），但保罗·利伯斯坦（Paul Lieberstein）告诉他，不行，用你孩子名字命名。

sentences.en: So that's how he got the name Mr. Isaac Sylvie.
sentences.zh: 所以他就得到了艾萨克·西尔维先生这个名字。

sentences.zh: 他由大卫·格兰特·赖特（David Grant Wright）饰演，他曾在《风骚律师》、《疯狂前女友》和《神烦警探》的多集里出现过，

sentences.en: and pretty much every soap opera you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 几乎演过你能想象到的每一部肥皂剧。

sentences.en: David is an incredible actor, and I read his bio.
sentences.zh: 大卫是个了不起的演员，我读过他的简历。

sentences.en: He is a 27-year cancer survivor.
sentences.zh: 他是战胜癌症27年的幸存者。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: He wrote a one-man show called With Flying Colors about his cancer experience, which he has performed for the last 25 years, raising thousands of dollars for cancer patients.
sentences.zh: 他写了一部名为《凯旋而归》（With Flying Colors）的独角戏，讲述了他抗癌的经历，并在过去25年里一直坚持表演，为癌症患者筹集了数千美元。

sentences.en: Good human alert.
sentences.zh: 好人警报。

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 好人警报。

sentences.en: That's fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, in this scene, Michael finds out that Isaac has driven all the way from Philly.
sentences.zh: 在这场戏里，迈克尔发现艾萨克是从费城一路开车过来的。

sentences.en: Michael's like, gosh, that's a heck of a drive.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔就说，天哪，这可真是好长一段车程。

sentences.en: And Isaac said, yeah, well, this is one of the few places hiring.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克说，是啊，不过这也是少数几个还在招人的地方了。

sentences.en: It's rough out there.
sentences.zh: 现在外面不好混啊。

sentences.en: And you sort of see the realization coming over Michael's face.
sentences.zh: 然后你能看到迈克尔脸上露出了恍然大悟的表情。

sentences.en: Jenna, there was more to the scene.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，这场戏其实还有更多内容。

sentences.en: And it was so good.
sentences.zh: 而且非常精彩。

sentences.en: I read it in the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 我在拍摄剧本里读到了。

sentences.en: He has his resume out, Isaac.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克拿出了他的简历。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, can I see that?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔就说，我能看看吗？

sentences.en: Michael is so blown away.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔大受震撼。

sentences.en: He finds out that Isaac was the president of the company he used to work at.
sentences.zh: 他发现艾萨克曾是他以前工作那家公司的总裁。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And now he's driving all the way from Philly for a regional manager position.
sentences.zh: 而现在他为了一个地区经理的职位，从费城一路开车过来。

sentences.en: Michael is so blown away by his resume.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔被他的简历深深地震撼了。

sentences.en: He says, can I keep this?
sentences.zh: 他说，这个我可以留着吗？

sentences.en: And then he really starts to spiral.
sentences.zh: 然后他真的开始情绪失控了。

sentences.zh: 他去找托比，向托比征求关于简历的建议，比如怎么把简历写得更丰富。

sentences.en: This made it into the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 这段被剪进删减片段里了。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 非常精彩。

sentences.en: Can we hear it?
sentences.zh: 我们能听听吗？

sentences.en: Hey, Toby, I have a real quick question for you.
sentences.zh: 嘿，托比，我有个很小的问题想问你。

sentences.en: It's about a resume.
sentences.zh: 关于一份简历的。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: So we might start with, so your most recent thing, you know, summary of achievements.
